description: This file is a header (.h) file that provides an interface for manipulating Python stack references within the PyTorch codebase. It declares a function to convert a stack reference to a Python object, conditionally compiled for Python 3.14+.

methods.name: THP_PyStackRef_AsPyObjectBorrow
methods.description: Converts a stack reference to a borrowed PyObject pointer, used internally within the PyTorch codebase to interface with Python.
